title: 住宿与租赁词汇
goal: 辨认住宿与租赁词汇，并按语境区分费用、服务项目与维修责任。

points.label: 辨认住宿与租赁的常用词
按语境区分费用与服务项目

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 听力课的内容、知识点与教学规格

body.p: 住宿咨询的词汇分四类：物品、费用、维修责任和入住手续。rent 是租金。deposit 是预先交的一笔钱，按协议处理。租房的押金和预订的订金用途可能不同，要看对话里的说明。

body.box: The monthly rent is £620. A separate deposit is held until the room is returned. Electricity is charged separately.

body.p: furnished 是配有家具，不是所有服务都免费。inclusive 要听清包含哪几项。维修由谁负责，看对话里怎么分工，不凭 landlord 或 tenant 的身份判断。

body.box: The flat is furnished, but heating isn't included in the rent.

cards.title: 词汇表：房间设施
rows: The agency offers temporary accommodation near the station.
The furnished flat has a bed and a desk.
The kitchen appliances include a cooker and a fridge.
隔热或隔音材料；隔热或隔音
The roof insulation helps reduce heat loss.
The bedroom opens onto a private balcony.
The plates are in the kitchen cupboard.
There is an electrical socket beside the desk.
The residents share a communal kitchen.
The bedroom furniture belongs to the landlord.
cards.note: furnished 是配有家具，communal 是共用，两个词都与费用无关。The room is furnished; the kitchen is communal. 说的是两件事。

cards.title: 词汇表：租期费用
rows: The six-month tenancy starts in October.
The applicant will read the lease before signing it.
The monthly rent is payable on the first day of each month.
A separate refundable deposit is required under this agreement.
The first month's rent is paid in advance.
分期付款中的一期款项
The fee can be paid in monthly instalments.
The quoted rent is inclusive of heating.
The tenant pays for utilities separately.
An additional surcharge applies to the optional storage space.
The payment is refundable if the stated conditions are met.
cards.note: inclusive 包含的范围看 of 后面，inclusive of heating 只含供暖。refundable 也可能带条件：refundable if cancelled by Friday，周六取消就不退。

cards.title: 词汇表：维修责任
rows: The tenant contacted the landlord about a broken handle.
The new tenant reported the fault on arrival.
Routine maintenance includes checking the heating system.
The leaking pipe needs an urgent repair.
The electrician found an electrical fault in the cooker.
A water leak has left the cupboard damp.
The report describes accidental damage to the shelf.
The agreement states who has responsibility for repairs.
A routine inspection is arranged for Tuesday.
A maintenance contractor will replace the faulty tap.
cards.note: maintenance 是日常维护，repair 是修复故障，inspection 只是检查。The inspection found a leak; a repair is still needed. 说明查出了问题，还没有修。

cards.title: 词汇表：入住手续
rows: The agent arranged a viewing before accepting applications.
The rental application includes contact details.
The applicant provided a reference from a previous landlord.
A relative agreed to act as a guarantor for the tenant.
The tenancy agreement records the rent and the start date.
The tenant checked the inventory against the furniture in the flat.
The agreement requires a signature from each named tenant.
The agent asked for proof of identification.
The receipt confirms that the deposit was paid.
The room is offered for single occupancy.
cards.note: application 是提出申请，还没有获批。receipt 证明已付款，inventory 记录家具的状况：The receipt records payment; the inventory records the furniture's condition.

body.box:
A: Does the £640 cover everything for the flat?
B: That's the monthly rent, inclusive of heating. Electricity is paid separately. A £400 deposit is also required and is held separately from the rent.
A: Is the flat furnished?
B: Yes. Check the inventory when moving in. It lists the furniture and its condition.
A: Who should be contacted about a fault?
B: Report it to the landlord, who will arrange a contractor.

body.p: £640 是每月租金，£400 是单独保管的押金。inclusive of heating 说明供暖已含，electricity is paid separately 说明电费另付。
inventory 用来核对物品和状况，receipt 只证明付款。本段中房东负责安排维修，维修由 contractor 来做。

body.box:
Which statement matches the charges?
1. Heating and electricity are both included in £640.
2. The £400 is the regular monthly rent.
3. Heating is included, but electricity is separate.
4. The deposit replaces the electricity payment.

body.p: 第三项分清了包含和另付的费用。第一项把电费也算进了租金。

items.stem: A resident shares a kitchen with other occupants. Which adjective describes that kitchen?
items.why: shares a kitchen 是共用，对应 communal，即第二项。private 是一人独用。

items.stem: An applicant reads the document setting out the rental period and conditions before signing. Which noun names that document?
items.why: document setting out the rental period and conditions 对应 lease，即第三项。inventory 只记录物品和状况。

items.stem: The agent arranges a visit so an applicant can see the room before applying. What is that visit?
items.why: see the room before applying 是看房，对应 viewing，即第四项。inspection 是检查房屋的问题。

items.stem: Water escapes from a pipe beneath the sink. Which word names the problem itself?
items.why: Water escapes from a pipe 是漏水，对应 leak，即第一项。repair 是修复漏水的行动。

items.stem: The contract asks for a person who will cover unpaid rent if the tenant cannot pay. Which role is required?
items.why: cover unpaid rent if the tenant cannot pay 对应担保人 guarantor，即第二项。

items.stem: A payer receives a document confirming that the deposit has been paid. What is the document?
items.why: confirming that the deposit has been paid 对应 receipt，即第三项。inventory 记录的是物品。

lines.text: I'm interested in the attic flat. Is the quoted amount the rent or the deposit?
The rent is five hundred pounds a month. The deposit is three hundred and is held separately. Water is included in the rent, but electricity is billed separately.
So the three hundred doesn't pay for the first month?
That's right. The first month's rent is still due.

items.stem: What is the £300 payment?
items.why: The deposit is three hundred and is held separately 说明 £300 是押金，即第一项。它不抵首月租金。

items.stem: Which service is included in the rent?
items.why: Water is included 和 electricity is billed separately 说明租金只含水费，即第四项。

lines.text: I'm checking the terms for the garden studio. Is routine maintenance my responsibility?
For this studio, the landlord arranges maintenance and pays the contractor. The tenant must report faults promptly. Accidental damage is dealt with under a separate clause.
Does an inspection mean that a fault has been repaired?
No. The inspection identifies problems. Any repair is arranged after that.

items.stem: What is the tenant asked to do?
options: Report faults as soon as they occur
items.why: The tenant must report faults promptly 对应报告职责；安排和付款归房东。

items.stem: What does the inspection establish?
items.why: The inspection identifies problems 说明检查只找出问题，即第三项。维修在检查之后安排。

items.stem: A flat comes with a bed, chairs and a wardrobe. Which adjective describes this provision?
items.why: comes with a bed, chairs and a wardrobe 是配有家具，对应 furnished，即第一项。

items.stem: Which document lists the furniture and records its condition at the start of a tenancy?
items.why: lists the furniture and records its condition 对应 inventory，即第四项。receipt 只证明付款。

items.stem: Which term names the regular charge for occupying a rented home, rather than a separately held security payment?
items.why: regular charge for occupying a rented home 对应 rent；separately held security payment 对应 deposit。

items.stem: The bill groups water, gas and electricity together. Which term covers these services?
items.why: water, gas and electricity 是公用服务，对应 utilities，即第三项。

items.stem: Which term describes routine work to keep a property in good condition, rather than a single check of its condition?
items.why: routine work to keep ... in good condition 对应 maintenance；a single check 对应 inspection。

items.stem: Who promises to cover unpaid rent if the tenant cannot pay, under the stated arrangement?
items.why: promises to cover unpaid rent if the tenant cannot pay 对应 guarantor，即第三项。

lines.text: Hello, I'm enquiring about the room above the bicycle workshop. Is the advertised six hundred pounds the full monthly rent?
Yes, it's inclusive of heating and water. Electricity isn't included and is charged separately. There's also a refundable deposit of four hundred pounds, held separately from the rent.
Does paying that deposit cover my first month?
No, the first month's rent is payable in advance as well. The deposit is dealt with under the return conditions in the agreement.
Thanks. I'll read those conditions before submitting the application.

items.stem: Which statement correctly separates the two payments?
options: The deposit replaces the first month's rent.
The deposit does not cover the first month.
The rent is held until the deposit is returned.
The deposit is the monthly heating charge.
items.why: first month's rent is payable in advance as well 表明租金与押金分别支付。

items.stem: Which service will require a separate payment?
options: Water and heating, but not electricity
Water and electricity, but not heating
Electricity, but not heating or water
items.why: inclusive of heating and water 说明供暖和水费已含。Electricity isn't included 说明只有电费另付，即第四项。

lines.text: I'm considering the flat beside the repair depot. What happens if an appliance develops a fault during the tenancy?
For this flat, report it to the landlord. The landlord arranges a contractor and pays for routine repairs. Damage caused by the tenant is considered separately under the agreement.
Is there a document showing the condition of the appliances when I arrive?
Yes, the inventory records them and their condition. Check it before signing. The payment receipt only confirms that money has been received.
Understood. I'll compare the inventory with the appliances in the flat.

items.stem: What is the stated procedure for routine repairs?
options: The tenant appoints and pays the contractor.
The contractor signs the tenant's inventory first.
The landlord organises and pays for the work.
The landlord treats every fault as tenant damage.
items.why: The landlord arranges a contractor and pays for routine repairs 说明由房东安排并付费，即第三项。

items.stem: Which document should be used to check the appliances' initial condition?
options: The receipt confirming the first payment
items.why: the inventory records them and their condition 说明用 inventory 核对初始状况，即第一项。receipt 只证明付款。
